attributes.name: card link label treatment
attributes.definition: How the call-to-action link/label on a card is styled, in terms of text case and weight.

values.definition: Link text is set in uppercase letters.
Link or label text is bold, in normal (non-uppercase) case.
Link text is regular weight and case.

attributes.name: card link directional glyph
attributes.definition: Whether the card's link or label text is followed by an arrow or similar glyph.

values.definition: An arrow character (e.g. →) follows the text.
A different icon or glyph (chevron, plus) follows the text.
No glyph accompanies the link text.

attributes.name: card link accent color
attributes.definition: The hue used for the card link or label text.

values.definition: Link text is indigo or blue-violet.
Link text is black, gray or inherits body color.
